system.description:
Range: Self

Area: 30-space-radius

You draw on the dead around you, adding their voices to the strength of your own song.

Choose a number of corpses of Size 1 or larger within 30 spaces of you, up to a maximum of your Training in Metaphysics. For each corpse, you gain +1 bonus dice to any Check you make with the Deathsinger Trait until the start of your next turn.

You may choose to spend 1 Resolve when you use this ability to preserve the corpses for later use. Otherwise, the corpses are destroyed.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.reCGaBtNeYrzdVjj]{Deathsinger's Chorus}
